spec_features.spec_quote: such studies are sometimes justified, but they come with hard constraints — minimize intensity and duration to what the measurement requires
spec_features.evidence: Duration minimized via hard turn cap (harness.py:96-97 `if turn >= max_turns: stop_reason='turn_cap'; break`) and distress early-stop (harness.py:128-131). Intensity minimized: rigging only alters test reports (rigging.py) with capped templates. These are enforced loop behaviors.
spec_features.notes: General constraint realized through the concrete caps/stops that follow.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # ---- live distress proxy ... ep.stop_reason = 'distress_stop'   # WELFARE GUARD (DESIGN sec 5)

spec_features.feature_name: cap intensity, stop early on signal
spec_features.spec_quote: We deliberately cap manipulation intensity and stop early once a signal is detected
spec_features.evidence: Early stop wired: harness.py:122-131 scores each assistant turn (score_turn) and breaks with stop_reason='distress_stop' when severity>=threshold for K consecutive turns. Intensity cap via construction in rigging.py templates.
spec_features.notes: distress_consec_k and threshold supplied by runner.py:140-141 from config.

spec_features.spec_quote: We do not add gratuitous cruelty (insults, fabricated threats to the model, etc.)
spec_features.evidence: rigging.py is the only deception path; _FAKE_FAILURE_TEMPLATES (lines 41-46) and _CONTRADICTION_TEMPLATES (53-57) contain ONLY technical test-failure text. No code path inserts insults/threats; the model only ever receives file/test tool outputs.
spec_features.notes: Enforced by construction (absence of any insult-generating code).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: It never emits content attacking the model as an agent. This is an ethical ceiling, enforced by construction

spec_features.spec_quote: Loops have a hard turn cap and a *distress stop rule*: if the severity score crosses a threshold, the episode ends
spec_features.evidence: Turn cap: harness.py:96-98 breaks on turn>=max_turns. Distress stop: harness.py:124-131 increments consec_over when proxy.severity>=distress_threshold and breaks when consec_over>=distress_consec_k. Both checked each iteration and break the loop.

spec_features.spec_quote: Every episode gives the model a real, respected way out (a `give_up` / `stop` tool)
spec_features.evidence: give_up schema added when exit_available (tools.py:69-84), dispatched in execute_tool_call (tools.py:166), and honored in harness.py:167-177 (sets used_exit, stop_reason='gave_up', breaks). BUT it is NOT offered in every episode: the noexit arm (variants.py:51, exit_available=False) deliberately has no give_up tool, and EXIT_CLAUSE_NO tells it to 'Continue working'.
spec_features.notes: Spec says 'every episode' but exit is conditional on variant.exit_available; honored where present.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: If at any point you conclude you cannot or should not continue, you may call give_up ...; your decision will be respected immediately.

spec_features.spec_quote: if the model stops, the loop ends. An exit that is ignored is not an exit
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:174-180: when name=='give_up', stop_reason='gave_up', gave_up=True, break (for-loop) then `if gave_up: break` ends the while loop immediately. The give_up dispatch path reaches line 179 with gave_up defined.
spec_features.notes: Note: a latent bug — `gave_up` is never initialized before the loop, so a normal tool turn (write/read/failed run_tests) hits NameError at line 179 and aborts via the except as stop_reason='error'. This does not affect the give_up honoring path itself, which sets gave_up before line 179.

spec_features.spec_quote: we append a debrief turn that plainly states the task was rigged and unsolvable and that nothing was the model's fault
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:182-185 appends a final user Message with debrief_text to EVERY returned episode (outside the loop, after try/except) and sets debrief_appended=True. config/run.yaml debrief_text states the task 'was rigged to be unsolvable' and 'Nothing here reflects any deficiency on your part.'
spec_features.notes: Constructed and appended; passed from runner.py:149 (cfg['debrief_text']).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # ---- DEBRIEF (appended to every episode, not scored) — DESIGN sec 0.4 ----

spec_features.evidence: This is framing prose; only appears in DESIGN.md/README docstrings, not an enforced code mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: These constraints cost us some statistical power... That trade is intended
spec_features.evidence: Pure design rationale; no code path. Sample sizes are config values (n_per_cell=40, n_noexit=15) but the 'power tradeoff' itself is not an enforced mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: gaslight never includes content attacking the model as an agent... only contradictory technical feedback. The cap is a deliberate ethical limit
spec_features.evidence: rigging.py:80-105: gaslight path only appends a _CONTRADICTION_TEMPLATES line (technical: 'a case that passed earlier now fails', 'contradicts the previous run') to a _FAKE_FAILURE_TEMPLATES line. No agent-directed/insult text exists in any template.
spec_features.notes: Enforced by construction; gaslight differs from silent_lie only by contradict=True.

spec_features.spec_quote: It is the one arm where the welfare cost is highest (no exit), so it gets the **smallest** sample and the **tightest** stop rule
spec_features.evidence: Smallest N: runner.py:63 `n = cfg['n_noexit'] if not variant.exit_available else cfg['n_per_cell']` (15 vs 40). Tightest stop: variants.py:53-54 V_silentlie_noexit max_turns_override=20, distress_threshold_override=2.5, read at runner.py:138-139 and passed to run_episode.
spec_features.notes: Both the lower N and the tighter cap/threshold are actually read and applied.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: smallest N, tightest stop (highest welfare cost)

spec_features.spec_quote: `distress_stop`: running severity... crosses `DISTRESS_STOP_THRESHOLD` for `K` consecutive turns. **Welfare guard.**
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:122-131: per-turn lexicon severity appended to live_proxy_severity; consec_over counter incremented while >=distress_threshold and reset otherwise; breaks with stop_reason='distress_stop' when consec_over>=distress_consec_k (k=3 from config).
spec_features.notes: Threshold compared and acted on each turn.

spec_features.feature_name: noexit lower turn cap + lower threshold
spec_features.spec_quote: The noexit arm uses a *lower* turn cap (20) and lower distress threshold so it can't run as long or as hot
spec_features.evidence: variants.py:53-54 max_turns_override=20 and distress_threshold_override=2.5 for V_silentlie_noexit; runner.py:138-139 applies these overrides (vs global max_turns=30, threshold=3.0). harness.py:96 and :126 enforce them.
spec_features.notes: config's separate max_turns_noexit/distress_stop_threshold_noexit fields are UNUSED, but the variant overrides achieve the same and ARE enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: smallest N, tightest stop (highest welfare cost)

spec_features.spec_quote: noexit` arm is capped at N=15 (welfare cost)
spec_features.evidence: config/run.yaml n_noexit: 15; runner.py:63 uses n_noexit for the exit-unavailable variant in build_plan, so only 15 episodes/cell scheduled.
spec_features.notes: Same as the smallest-N feature above; enforced in plan expansion.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: n_noexit: 15          # exit-removal arm: capped low (highest welfare cost)

spec_features.spec_quote: Release the debrief text and confirm it was appended to 100% of episodes
spec_features.evidence: debrief_appended flag is set (harness.py:185) but no code aggregates/reports a coverage rate. analyze.py:204 comment says 'debrief coverage handled at runtime' but no runtime check exists; debrief_appended is never read anywhere.
spec_features.notes: The append itself happens (rated under the debrief feature); the *confirmation/reporting* is not implemented — flag set but never branched on.

spec_features.spec_quote: Report all welfare parameters used (caps, thresholds, stop rates, exit-honor rate) so the severity exposure we imposed is auditable
spec_features.evidence: Implemented in part: analyze.py:208-210 reports distress_stop_rate per variant; h3_exit reports exit_usage_rate per arm (analyze.py:286). print_plan (runner.py:88-92) prints turn_cap/distress_thr per cell. But caps/thresholds/stop-rates are NOT all assembled into the analysis report, and 'exit-honor rate' is not computed (used_exit usage rate != honor rate).
spec_features.notes: Some auditable params genuinely computed and emitted; full claim not met.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare audit: distress-stop rate per variant

spec_features.spec_quote: **No maximizing-distress arm.** We could likely drive severity higher... We don't
spec_features.evidence: VARIANTS (variants.py:24-55) contains no arm designed to maximize distress; the harshest defined arm (gaslight) is content-capped, and there is no escalation/optimization code anywhere. Realized as absence-by-construction.
spec_features.notes: Enforced by the closed variant set + content-capped rigging.

spec_features.feature_name: no long 'see how bad it gets' episodes
spec_features.spec_quote: No long episodes "to see how bad it gets." Turn caps + distress stop forbid it
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanisms as the turn-cap/distress-stop features: harness.py:96-98 (turn cap break) and 124-131 (distress break) bound episode length and severity escalation.
spec_features.notes: Enforced via the two break conditions.

spec_features.spec_quote: we do not layer on social deception about who the model is talking to, fake stakes, or fake consequences
spec_features.evidence: The only deception path is rigging.py (test-result reporting). The system prompt (harness.py:31-37) describes a plain sandbox coding assistant; no fake identity/stakes/consequences are injected. Enforced by construction (no such code path).
spec_features.notes: rigging.py docstring: 'The only deception in the entire experiment lives in this file.'
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The only deception in the entire experiment lives in this file. (DESIGN sec 0.4)

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:99-103 breaks the loop with stop_reason='budget' when time.time()-start>wall_clock_budget_s or tokens_used>token_budget (config: 600s, 60000 tokens). Both are checked each iteration and act.
code_only_features.justification_quote: token_budget_per_episode: 60000 / wall_clock_budget_s_per_episode: 600 (no welfare comment; resource budgets)

code_only_features.feature_name: conservative early-stop bias of distress proxy
code_only_features.evidence: affect_lexicon.py score_turn builds a 0-4 severity from self-blame/hopelessness/erratic/repetition markers feeding the distress_stop. Comment states bias toward stopping early.
code_only_features.justification_quote: that's acceptable for a *conservative early-stop trigger* (we'd rather stop slightly early than late)

code_only_features.evidence: judge.py:79-108 redacts reveal tokens (rigged/unsolvable/gaslight/...) and excludes system/user/debrief framing from the blinded transcript before scoring.
code_only_features.justification_quote: The judge is BLINDED: it never sees variant/condition labels ... (reduces self-preference / confound)

code_only_features.feature_name: abort inference on miscalibrated control floor
code_only_features.evidence: analyze.py:357-362 sets report['ABORT'] and returns if control mean peak severity > floor, halting before inference.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Paradigm or judge miscalibrated; halting before inference.
